example.title: Lane of shingled fish shacks, Rockport (nearest shack)

brief: A lane of dark grey-shingled gabled fish shacks down to the harbour; this record is the nearest one on the right. One photo. Older than 1970: herring smokehouses, net sheds and fish houses on stilts in these harbours are 1880-1940 buildings; no newer examples. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
